entries.source:
You can bind a non-passive talent to a hotkey by pressing the corresponding hotkey while selecting a talent or by right-clicking on the talent.
Check out the keybinding screen in the game menu to bind hotkeys to a key (default is 1-0 plus control, shift, or alt).
Right click or press '~' to configure talent confirmation and automatic use.
entries.target:
你可以通过选中技能时按下对应快捷键，或右键点击技能，将非被动技能绑定到快捷键上。
仔细检查一下游戏菜单中关于快捷键绑定的设置（默认情况下的快捷键是0～9，以及 Ctrl、Shift 或 Alt 与数字的组合键）。
右键点击或按'~'键可配置技能确认和自动使用。
最后希望的传令官哈诺

使用该技能不解除潜行。
#YELLOW#准备于：%s#LAST#

entries.source: This voratun shield, coated with thick vines, was imbued with nature's power long ago by the Halfling General Almadar Riul, who used it to stave off the magic and diseases of orcish corruptors during the peak of the Pyre Wars.
entries.target: 这块沃瑞钽盾牌表面被厚实的藤蔓所缠绕，其中注入了许多年前的半身人将军阿尔曼达·鲁伊尔的自然力量，他在烈火战争中用这个盾牌驱散了兽人堕落者的魔法与疾病。

entries.source:
After fighting back the other races we began to build and prosper. Finally we had our own towns and cities, and we began to advance our own abilities. Though battles were still ongoing at our borders we were free to thrive and prosper.

But then the accursed Shaloren mages began experimenting with Sher'Tul ruins. Oh what a dark and terrible a day it was for our race! The Spellblaze massacred our people. Earthquakes tore up our new-built towns, fires raged over old and young alike, and the whole world was turned to turmoil. Afterwards disease and blight ravaged our people, utterly ruining all the progress we had made.

Only the strongest of us lived through the dark times that followed. We fled east, back to our dark and hidden places, but our people swore terrible oaths of vengeance on the races that had brought such bloody ruin upon us.
entries.target:
在击退其他种族之后，我们开始建设家园、繁衍昌盛。我们终于拥有了自己的城镇与城市，并开始提升自身的能力。尽管边境上依然战事不断，我们仍得以自由地繁荣兴盛。

然而，那些该死的永恒精灵法师开始拿夏·图尔废墟进行实验。哦，对我族而言那是多么黑暗而可怕的一天！魔法大爆炸屠杀了我们的人民。地震撕裂了我们新建的城镇，烈火吞噬了老幼妇孺，整个世界都陷入了混乱。随后，疾病与枯萎疫病肆虐我族，将我们取得的一切成果彻底摧毁。

随后到来的黑暗时期里，唯有我们当中最强壮者才得以幸存。我们向东逃亡，回到了黑暗隐秘的避难所，但我们的族人发下了残酷的复仇誓言，誓要让那些将如此血腥毁灭降临于我们的种族血债血偿。
#{bold}#%s的精神攻击造成了致命一击！#{normal}#

带路吧，我会保护你的。
你周围的时间稳定了下来。
智慧的乌克勒姆斯维奇

entries.source:
Overcharge your psionic focus with energy for %d turns, producing a different effect depending on what it is.
		A telekinetically wielded melee weapon enters a frenzy, striking up to %d enemies per turn, also increases the radius by %d.
		A mindstar will attempt to pull in all enemies within its normal range.
		A gem will fire an energy bolt at a random enemy in range 6, each turn for %0.1f damage. The type is determined by the colour of the gem. Damage scales with Mindpower.
entries.target:
超载你的心灵聚焦 %d 轮，造成特殊效果。
		念动近战武器进入狂乱，每回合最多攻击 %d 个敌人，攻击半径同时增加 %d 格。
		灵晶会尝试将其正常范围内的所有敌人拉到身边。
		宝石每回合向 6 格内的一个随机敌人发射能量球，造成 %0.1f 伤害。伤害类型取决于宝石的颜色，伤害随精神强度提高。

entries.source: Showing big healthbars and tactical borders.
... and we thought the trollmire was safer now!
entries.target: …谁说巨魔沼泽比以前安全了！

entries.source: This azure ring seems to be always moist to the touch.
entries.target: 这枚碧蓝色的戒指摸起来似乎总是湿润的。

entries.source:
Invokes an arc of lightning doing %0.2f to %0.2f damage (%0.2f average) and chaining to another target.
		The arc can jump to %d targets at most, up to 10 grids apart, and will never jump to the same target twice, or to the caster. The arc will also strike all creatures between each target.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
召唤一道闪电链，造成 %0.2f 至 %0.2f 点闪电伤害（平均 %0.2f 点），随后跃向另一个目标。
		闪电链最多可跃向 %d 个目标，每次跃迁的两个目标之间最多相隔 10 格；不会重复命中同一目标，也不会跃向施法者。每次跃迁还会击中两个目标之间的所有生物。
		伤害随法术强度提高。

喔～！我们的客人终于来到了这里。我想你在山巅玩得很尽兴？
